topic_thesis: Your weekend movie ticket isn't just entertainment; it's a 570% tax-hike vehicle designed to extract your leisure budget through corporate proxy.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Tax Incidence Shifting' mechanism where PVR INOX acts as a government tax collector, forcing the consumer to bear the full weight of a 570% hike while the theater chain hides behind 'operational costs'.
target_emotion: Outrage at the hidden cost of leisure and feeling manipulated as a tax-paying tool.
pinned_comment_text: Is your weekend movie habit becoming a luxury you can't afford? Are you tired of hidden taxes being passed directly to your wallet? Comment 'GUIDE' to get our breakdown on how to spot these 'hidden tax' traps before you pay! 🍿📉

source_signal: Consumer frustration with rising cost of living and entertainment expenses.
